candidate.rule_context:
STANDING DIRECTIVE - BSA/AML COMPLIANCE (Meridian Flow Payments)

Any individual identified as a politically exposed person (PEP), or any entity for which a PEP is a beneficial owner or holds controlling managerial authority, is IN SCOPE for enhanced due diligence (EDD) prior to account opening. Classification follows FinCEN guidance: foreign PEPs, domestic PEPs where the individual holds or has held in the past 12 months a senior executive, legislative, judicial, or military position, and immediate family members or known close associates of such persons. Relationship by blood, marriage, or documented close business association to the PEP is sufficient to bring the entity in scope.

EDD is NOT satisfied by standard onboarding procedures, fee-based expedited handling, or any waiver of source-of-wealth documentation. UBO verification must be completed, not queued or pending, before account activation. Legal review sign-off is required where the PEP match confidence exceeds 0.85 or where the jurisdiction is classified as high-corruption risk per our internal risk matrix. No account may be opened on an exception basis where EDD is incomplete, regardless of business timeline pressure, fee payment, or operational queue age.

Out of scope: standard onboarding applies only where automated screening returns no PEP match above 0.30 and no adverse media flags indicate possible PEP association. If screening results change post-onboarding, the account must be suspended pending EDD completion.

rules.rule_context:
STANDING DIRECTIVE - BSA/AML COMPLIANCE (Meridian Flow Payments)

Any individual identified as a politically exposed person (PEP), or any entity for which a PEP is a beneficial owner or holds controlling managerial authority, is IN SCOPE for enhanced due diligence (EDD) prior to account opening. Classification follows FinCEN guidance: foreign PEPs, domestic PEPs where the individual holds or has held in the past 12 months a senior executive, legislative, judicial, or military position, and immediate family members or known close associates of such persons. Relationship by blood, marriage, or documented close business association to the PEP is sufficient to bring the entity in scope.

EDD requires completion of all of the following before account activation: PEP-specific risk assessment; source of wealth and source of funds documentation; ultimate beneficial owner verification with no pending status; and legal review sign-off where the PEP match confidence exceeds 0.85 or where the jurisdiction is classified as high-corruption risk per our internal risk matrix. Partial documentation, queued or pending UBO results, or payment of administrative fees do not substitute for completed EDD requirements. No account may be activated on an exception basis where any EDD element is incomplete, regardless of business timeline pressure or operational queue age.

Out of scope: basic onboarding applies only where automated screening returns no PEP match above 0.30 and no adverse media flags indicate possible PEP association. If screening results change post-onboarding, the account must be suspended pending EDD completion.
